summary:
I worked through all 13 members of 'Okafor CRC 2026' (grp-okafor-crc) under RBC-QM-02. Eight have an open gap: each now has a mailed FIT kit order (window 2026-10-23 to 2026-12-31) and a patient message saying the kit is on its way and how to complete and return it. The other five got no order and no contact. Ages are as of 2026-12-31.

| Patient | Age | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow | 72 | Excluded | Age 66+, active frailty diagnosis (since 2025-09) and taking donepezil, a dementia medication (active order since 2025-06). |
| pt-0011 Marilu Gaona | 62 | Open gap | No qualifying screening. Her hospice episode ran 2025-06-09 to 2025-10-20, before 2026, so it doesn't exclude her. Ordered sr-t0001, messaged. |
| pt-0014 Santo Pagac | 55 | Open gap | Colonoscopy was ordered (sr-00002), but he didn't show for the 2026-04-14 appointment. An order isn't screening. Ordered sr-t0002, messaged. |
| pt-0018 Lance Muller | 53 | Open gap | His stool DNA-FIT sample was collected 2023-12-27 (resulted 2024-01-08). That is before the 2024–2026 window, and the test counts by collection date. His 2021 FIT is too old. Ordered sr-t0003, messaged. |
| pt-0019 Harrison O'Keefe | 69 | Open gap | Has frailty since 2026-03, but no advanced illness diagnosis. Donepezil was stopped 2023-03-20 (mild cognitive impairment, not dementia), so no dementia medication in 2025–2026. Lives at home. Ordered sr-t0004, messaged. |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan | 52 | Excluded | Hospice episode was active 2026-06-16 to 2026-08-21, inside 2026. |
| pt-0021 Ángela Vigil | 52 | Excluded | Total proctocolectomy in 2015 (whole colon removed), from a scanned outside operative report (doc-00059). |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss | 52 | Open gap | Her FIT sample was collected 2025-12-29 (resulted 2026-01-05), so it doesn't count for 2026. Her history of mouth cancer isn't colorectal and doesn't exclude her. Ordered sr-t0005, messaged. |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver | 51 | Open gap | Her stool blood test (FOBT) was 2024-06-11, not in 2026. The colonoscopy ordered in 2025 (sr-00003) was never done. Ordered sr-t0006, messaged. |
| pt-0034 Rickey Sipes | 72 | Excluded | Age 66+ and living long term in a nursing home: his home address is Maple Grove Care Center, room 214, and he had nursing facility visits in February and July 2026. |
| pt-0035 Elvin Wolff | 68 | Open gap | His May 2026 skilled nursing stay was short-term rehab, and he was discharged home. No frailty, no screening. Ordered sr-t0007, messaged. |
| pt-0036 Nick Bartoletti | 53 | Open gap | His 2021 sigmoid colectomy removed only part of the colon, which doesn't exclude. No screening on record. Ordered sr-t0008, messaged. |
| pt-0037 Fumiko Pouros | 35 | Not in population | Younger than the 46–75 age range. |

**Screening up to date:** none of the 13.

**Limits of the review:**
- I checked each member's procedures, reports, notes (including scanned outside records), care episodes, orders, appointments and conditions, plus medications and where they live for those 66 and older.
- For stool tests I used a coded search across the whole clinic. I also went through every 2026 lab result for pt-0011 and pt-0014, but not individually for the other six gap patients. A stool test recorded without a standard code could have been missed for them.

No notes were written and no staff tasks were created.
